items.followUp: Define Young’s modulus and derive its equation in terms of force, cross-sectional area, original length and extension.

rubric.why: Young’s modulus is the ratio of stress to strain within the elastic limit.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating the ratio and the elastic-limit condition.

rubric.why: Stress equals force divided by cross-sectional area.
Strain equals extension divided by original length.
Substituting the stress and strain expressions gives the required equation.
rubric.description: Derive the equation for Young’s modulus.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the derived equation Y = FL/(AΔL).

modelAnswer: Young’s modulus is the ratio of stress to strain within the elastic limit.
